text:
Aisha (PM): quick quarterly pulse — can folks call out what actually shipped vs slipped for OKR-Infra & OKR-Serving this quarter? list owner + 1-line status pls.
Marco (Eng): OKR-Serving: shipped core streaming handler + rollout to canary (owner: Marco). Canary perf looks good at p95 ~ 110ms. still pending full rollout.
Ella (SRE): OKR-Infra: Dedicated capacity autoscale rules were merged but we hit quota limits in us-west last week so dedicated bursts slipped (owner: Ella).
Devon (Infra): blocked by cloud quota bump — request to cloud applied, support ticket #78921. ETA is 48–72h. until that lands we can't enable extra pools.
Marco (Eng): also FYI a perf regression popped in canary for long-seq prompts when kv-cache grows. PR linked and awaiting review: <https://git.internal/r/redwood/serve/pull/4321>. tag: @Rob for kernel selection changes.
Rob (Staff Eng): I can take the review today, will try to split the change into a low-risk fallback + perf opt. suggest adding a canary flag: `--kv-safe-fallback`.
Aisha (PM): thanks — so concrete: shipped = streaming handler; slipped = dedicated burst autoscale and long-seq perf fix. next steps: (1) Devon escalate quota (2) Rob merge fallback (3) Marco coordinate full rollout once infra OK. owners confirm?
Devon (Infra): confirming. escalated to premium queue, put on pager for follow-up. cc @cloud-ops.
Rob (Staff Eng): confirming, aim to open a small PR this afternoon and request a patch release.
Marco (Eng): confirming, holding final rollout until fallback is in prod; will update the rollout doc at `docs/rollouts/serving-canary.md`.
ci-bot: deployment job `canary/serve-v2` triggered by Marco. build #1543.
Aisha (PM): excellent. can everyone drop 1-sentence update in this thread when their item moves to "done" so I can capture in the OKR doc? :thumbsup:
Ella (SRE): noted — will update here once quota is verified and extra nodes are available.
Marco (Eng): will post when rollout reaches 100%.
Rob (Staff Eng): will post when fallback is merged and cherry-picked to release branch.
Aisha (PM): last ask — any downstream teams that need a heads-up? e.g., mobile/ux for latency SLAs?
Marco (Eng): tagging @mobile: we saw ~10–15% improvement from streaming handler; will send brief note to mobile leads.
Aisha (PM): perfect. thanks all — I’ll synthesize into the quarterly OKR doc after the done pings.
